milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The blue wool block is placed at spawn-relative (8, 0, 5) inside an oak plank room with a west-facing doorway. The player must navigate the courtyard, locate the room, find the doorway, and approach the blue wool while facing it. max_distance=3 ensures the player has actually navigated to or entered the room (spawn is ~9.4 blocks away from the target, so the player must cover significant distance). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the blue wool, confirming visual identification rather than accidental proximity.
